winter_18.000.source: I think Jas actually likes going to the doctor. What an unusual little girl.
winter_18.000.translation: Cred că lui Jas chiar îi place să meargă la doctor. Ce fetiță neobișnuită.

fall_18.000.source: Erm... Doctor Harvey? This is completely confidential, right?
fall_18.000.translation: Ăă... doctore Harvey? Totul este strict confidențial, nu?

winter_18.002.source: Erm... Doctor Harvey? When you give her the shots, can we have two lollipops?

winter_16.000.source: Oohh... Fine purple silk. You can't find that at JojaMart!
